text: The dining hall is prepared for a feast. The Elf Lord sits at the head of the table while Moth-in-Water juggles three blades beside him. Two child servers stand at attention, dressed as if the court has taught them to forget their own names.

views.text: Oak panels and a cold chandelier surround the table. Amelia and Bernard Goodall carry service cloths; their fixed smiles break when a familiar village phrase reaches them.
A generous banquet glows beneath a chandelier of stars. Two young attendants smile as honoured pages, and Moth-in-Water welcomes the party to an elegant family supper.
